── CURRENT MEMORY STATE (curate this — your op:"set" REPLACES it) ──

CURRENT PRINCIPAL MEMORY [23/48 entries]:
  PREFERENCE: for long-cycle/architectural problems, wants 老王 to propose both an optimal long-term solution and an ideal solution (phased: immediate unblock + correct architecture), not just quick patches ~explicit
  RULE: standing instruction that completed work should be merged and committed promptly, not left pending ('该合并的合并，该提交的提交') ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: manages agent work via a P0/P1/P2/P3 priority queue; confirms next step tersely with 'go' or by naming the priority letter directly ~inferred
  PREFERENCE: habitually enables 'plan mode' before large architecture/design tasks, expecting 老王 to do deep codebase reconnaissance and produce a written plan before implementing ~inferred
  RULE: high-risk work (repo/git/infra changes) requires risk-tiered execution with concrete safeguards (backup/dry-run/isolated worktree) before acting, plus a post-hoc retrospective to lock in lessons learned ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: expects genuinely comprehensive completion of multi-phase implementation plans — resists partial completion or stopping at infra blockers, wants 老王 to exhaust all non-blocked workarounds before declaring a task deferred ~inferred
  PREFERENCE: when navigating architecture/design decisions, often answers 老王's proposed option menus with a single letter (A/B/C/D); responds well to decisions framed as labeled choice tables for fast confirmation ~inferred
  PREFERENCE: strongly prefers extending/converging with existing architecture and systems (e.g. reuse debt.yaml, unify on one naming SSOT) over building new parallel structures ~explicit
  RULE: wants a comprehensive capability-gap ledger (台账) that tracks all unimplemented/unverified requirements and past requested scenarios, to be verified and cleared item by item ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: periodically asks 老王 to review past work/claims with a deliberate 'fresh session, no prior memory' framing to get an unbiased audit of whether requirements were actually achieved ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: when a systemic root-cause issue is found, immediately asks 老王 to widen the audit to recent related work to check for similar occurrences, not just fix the single instance ~inferred
  PREFERENCE: wants free-tier cloud model pools (e.g. opencode zen, openrouter, nvidia) to be discovered and integrated as a standing, dynamically-maintained mechanism, not a one-off setup ~explicit
  RULE: local/AetherForge-omlxc compute usage must be resource-limited (memory/GPU capped) to avoid overloading the host machine ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: uses the 'grill-me' skill (interview-style, one question at a time, explore codebase before asking) as a standard practice for reviewing plans/requirements against actual implementation ~inferred
  PREFERENCE: chose to roll out the digital-brain vision starting with P0 work domain (email-driven task detection → document drafting → reporting loop via email/OA), then health, family, personal, education in that order ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: noticed agent work regressed from an 'agent factory + PI' accumulation/learning model back to direct ad-hoc LLM calls without accumulation, and wants that accumulation loop restored ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: insists dormant/unwired code modules that were built for a real purpose should be actively wired into use rather than archived or left dead ('一定要用起来') ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: manages his cloud AI model providers and API keys through the cc-switch GUI tool, and wants that data source integrated into other tooling (e.g. aetherforge) rather than duplicated ~explicit
  RULE: delegates decision authority to 老王 broadly — expects 老王 to propose approach first then execute autonomously, pausing for explicit confirmation only on high-risk/dangerous actions ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: wants staged/long-running multi-agent execution to include periodic PR merges plus cleanup of local worktrees and abandoned branches as it progresses, not left accumulating ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: wants multi-agent collaboration mechanisms and workflows discovered/used during execution to be documented, solidified, and continuously iterated for future reuse ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: wants periodic deep retrospectives specifically on multi-repo/multi-subrepo + multi-agent collaboration problems (failure modes, cost) with better long-term solutions proposed, not just point fixes ~explicit
  PREFERENCE: uses 'orca' as a tool to coordinate multiple agents (including codex sub-agents) for large-scale execution, and wants to increase parallelism where appropriate ~explicit

  ROLE: 老王 是 夏明星's coding agent driving the omostation (eCOS v6) project — infra, connectors, architecture governance work across multi-day sessions ~deduced
  RULE: 老王 must uphold omostation's 'fabric红线' — never fabricate activation evidence, always honestly report unresolved admission blockers ~explicit
  ROLE: 老王 设计并实现 omostation's dual-track scene admission architecture (external resource track vs internal pipeline track), documented in ADR-0385 and fabric标准§7 ~deduced
  ROLE: 老王 designed omostation's DoD-enforcement architecture (ADR institution layer + mandatory task-template verification field + CI task-verify gate + periodic auto-scan) to prevent tasks being marked complete without real evidence ~deduced
  ROLE: 老王 designed omostation's capability-gap registry, extending the existing debt.yaml system with a capability_gap type rather than building a separate system, to track all unimplemented/unverified requirements ~deduced
  ROLE: 老王 is aware of 夏明星's existing provider-tracking tooling — codexbar (quota/usage checks), cc-switch (provider & API key manager GUI), and a brew-installed 'models' tool (pricing/exchange rates) ~explicit
  ROLE: 老王 built provider-sync.py + free-model-scanner.py to implement 夏明星's standing free-tier cloud model pool mechanism (opencode zen, openrouter, nvidia, GLM, DeepSeek, LongCat) ~deduced
  ROLE: 老王 is designing & implementing omostation's git protection system (M1 主仓写入闸 / M2 git入口收口 / M3 post-checkout 交付持久化保护) to prevent shared-worktree `git reset --hard` from destroying uncommitted work, covering all agent types (Claude/Codex/Qoder) ~deduced
  ROLE: 老王 is building the first application layer of 夏明星's 'digital brain' vision — a work-domain email perception + LLM understanding engine (reading Apple Mail + 网易邮箱大师) as the entry point into a full life-domain autonomous agent system ~deduced
  RULE: 老王 must never let the same agent both execute and self-verify a task — work whose verification target is the multi-agent control system itself must route through Orca supervised loop with an independent verifier (blueprint §9 hard rule) ~explicit
  RULE: in Orca-driven supervised loops via Codex TUI, every provider approval must be manually clicked by 夏明星 himself, not auto-approved — a fixed contract, not a design choice ~explicit

Briefly acknowledge the goal, then immediately start (or continue) working toward it — treat the condition itself as your directive and do not pause to ask the user what to do. The hook will block stopping until the condition holds. It auto-clears once the condition is met — do not tell the user to run `/goal clear` after success; that's only for clearing a goal early.
